01-entra-credential-expiration-audit.name: Expiring secrets and certificates
01-entra-credential-expiration-audit.key: Secrets and certificates expire without warning
01-entra-credential-expiration-audit.symptom: An app stopped working overnight because a secret or a certificate expired, and nobody saw it coming.
01-entra-credential-expiration-audit.does: Every month it checks every app registration and service principal in Microsoft Entra ID and lists the secrets and certificates that have expired or are about to, sorted by urgency, so they can be renewed in time.
01-entra-credential-expiration-audit.delivers: Interactive HTML report with filters and CSV export
01-entra-credential-expiration-audit.caption: Sample report with fictitious data.

02-arc-defender-posture-audit.name: Security posture from Defender for Cloud
02-arc-defender-posture-audit.key: Too many security findings to know where to start
02-arc-defender-posture-audit.symptom: Defender for Cloud shows hundreds of recommendations and we don't know which ones matter first.
02-arc-defender-posture-audit.does: It reads the live Defender for Cloud evidence of a subscription (risks, recommendations, attack paths, vulnerabilities and secure score) and turns it into one report that shows what to review first. Then you can ask follow-up questions grounded in that evidence.
02-arc-defender-posture-audit.caption: Lab run. Field marks: 1 report title and live scope · 2 the sections (posture, attack paths, resources, recommendations, CVEs, compliance, sources).

13-rbac-privileged-access-review.name: Privileged access review
13-rbac-privileged-access-review.key: Too many people have Owner on our subscriptions
13-rbac-privileged-access-review.symptom: Too many people and apps are Owner on our subscriptions, and nobody knows who still needs it.
13-rbac-privileged-access-review.does: It reviews every privileged Azure role assignment, checks each identity in Microsoft Entra ID, and separates what can be removed today without anyone losing access from what needs an owner's decision.
13-rbac-privileged-access-review.reads: Azure role assignments and Microsoft Entra ID
13-rbac-privileged-access-review.caption: Real lab run with names and identifiers replaced.

03-infrastructure-operations-health.name: Server health and capacity
03-infrastructure-operations-health.key: No single view of server health, in Azure and on-premises
03-infrastructure-operations-health.symptom: We run servers in Azure and on-premises, and nobody has one view of CPU, memory and what is about to run out.
03-infrastructure-operations-health.does: It collects CPU, memory, capacity, health and alerts for Azure virtual machines and Azure Arc servers, and explains them in one monthly operations review that flags unusual behaviour and says clearly where data is missing.
03-infrastructure-operations-health.reads: Azure Monitor, Log Analytics and Azure Arc
03-infrastructure-operations-health.delivers: HTML report, two CSVs and JSON
03-infrastructure-operations-health.caption: Lab run. Field marks: 1 report title and time window · 2 the fleet register of Azure and Arc machines.

05-service-health-events-review.name: Azure incidents and planned maintenance
05-service-health-events-review.key: We hear about Azure incidents from our users
05-service-health-events-review.symptom: Azure had an incident, or planned maintenance, and we found out from our own users.
05-service-health-events-review.does: It gathers the service incidents and planned maintenance that Microsoft has published for your subscriptions, the resources that may be affected and what is coming next, in one monthly review.
05-service-health-events-review.delivers: HTML report, two CSVs and JSON
05-service-health-events-review.caption: Lab run. Field marks: 1 the review window, stated before any result · 2 communications to review, by lane.

06-azure-backup-operations-review.name: Backup jobs review
06-azure-backup-operations-review.key: Nobody reviews the failed backup jobs
06-azure-backup-operations-review.symptom: We assume backups work, but nobody looks at the failed jobs until the day we need a restore.
06-azure-backup-operations-review.does: It reviews the backup jobs, errors and warnings of your Recovery Services vaults and which items are protected, so IT operations can decide what needs action. It never starts, stops or changes a backup.
06-azure-backup-operations-review.delivers: HTML report, two CSVs and JSON
06-azure-backup-operations-review.caption: Lab run. Field marks: 1 requested window · 2 approved vaults and coverage note · 3 full downloads · 4 expected protection shown as Unknown, never guessed.

09-update-manager-patching-failure-inves.name: Patching results and failed machines
09-update-manager-patching-failure-inves.key: Patching failed and nobody knows why
09-update-manager-patching-failure-inves.symptom: After every patching window someone has to log in to each failed server to find out why it didn't patch.
09-update-manager-patching-failure-inves.does: After each patching cycle it checks every Azure virtual machine and Azure Arc server in Azure Update Manager and, for each machine that failed, explains the most likely cause from the evidence Azure already has.
09-update-manager-patching-failure-inves.delivers: HTML report, two CSVs and JSON
09-update-manager-patching-failure-inves.caption: Lab run, report in Spanish. Field marks: 1 exports · 2 report cover and scope · 3 summary of the patching cycle.

10-operations-incidents-anomalies-digest.name: Monthly operations digest
10-operations-incidents-anomalies-digest.key: Operations signals are scattered in five places
10-operations-incidents-anomalies-digest.symptom: Alerts, health events and Advisor tips live in five different places, and management wants one monthly picture with actions.
10-operations-incidents-anomalies-digest.does: It brings together Azure Monitor alerts, Service Health, failed extensions, telemetry anomalies and Azure Advisor into one operations report with a prioritised list of recommended actions.
10-operations-incidents-anomalies-digest.reads: Azure Monitor, Service Health, Log Analytics and Azure Advisor
10-operations-incidents-anomalies-digest.delivers: HTML report, two CSVs and JSON
10-operations-incidents-anomalies-digest.caption: Lab run, report in Spanish. Field marks: 1 report header · 2 exports and sections · 3 executive synthesis with the counts.

12-sqlmi-maintenance-resilience.name: SQL Managed Instance maintenance
12-sqlmi-maintenance-resilience.key: Users see errors when Azure patches our databases
12-sqlmi-maintenance-resilience.symptom: Every time Azure patches our SQL Managed Instances, users see errors, and we want to choose the hour like we did on-premises.
12-sqlmi-maintenance-resilience.does: It shows each instance's maintenance window, the real interruptions and how long they lasted, the next planned maintenance, which applications show errors to users and which recover on their own, and the best window based on real load.
12-sqlmi-maintenance-resilience.reads: Azure SQL, Service Health, Azure Monitor and Application Insights
12-sqlmi-maintenance-resilience.delivers: HTML report, two CSVs and JSON
12-sqlmi-maintenance-resilience.caption: Sample report in demo mode (simulated data), in Spanish.

04-aks-well-architected-review.name: AKS cluster review
04-aks-well-architected-review.key: Our Kubernetes clusters may not follow best practices
04-aks-well-architected-review.symptom: Our Kubernetes clusters grew fast, and we are not sure they follow best practices or what they really cost.
04-aks-well-architected-review.does: It reviews the configuration of approved AKS clusters, their workloads and related resources against best practices for security, cost and optimisation, and proposes an improved reference design without deploying anything.
04-aks-well-architected-review.reads: Azure Kubernetes Service and related resources
04-aks-well-architected-review.delivers: HTML report, two CSVs and JSON
04-aks-well-architected-review.caption: Lab run, report in Spanish. Field marks: 1 report cover · 2 evidence labels (observed, lab) · 3 cluster facts: region, AKS version, state.

08-databricks-dependency-configuration-r.name: Databricks dependencies and configuration
08-databricks-dependency-configuration-r.key: No map of what our Databricks workspace depends on
08-databricks-dependency-configuration-r.symptom: Our Databricks workspace connects to many things, and nobody has the full map or knows whether it is secure and cost-efficient.
08-databricks-dependency-configuration-r.does: It maps how an Azure Databricks workspace connects to networks, storage, Key Vault, jobs, pipelines and Unity Catalog, marking what is observed, inferred or unknown, and checks 36 best practices for security, cost and optimisation.
08-databricks-dependency-configuration-r.delivers: HTML report, two CSVs and JSON
08-databricks-dependency-configuration-r.caption: Lab run, report in Spanish. Field marks: 1 exports (JSON, dependencies, findings) · 2 workspace cover and scope · 3 executive reading and coverage.

11-fabric-finops-chargeback.name: Microsoft Fabric costs and savings
11-fabric-finops-chargeback.key: Fabric capacity costs more than it is used
11-fabric-finops-chargeback.symptom: We pay for Microsoft Fabric every month, but we don't know what is really used, which teams and people use it, or how much we could save.
11-fabric-finops-chargeback.does: It reads the real bill, the hours the capacity is switched on and who uses what, then shows idle time, savings options (pause, resize or reserve), a cost split per workspace, and what each user group and person consumes on the resources they can access.
11-fabric-finops-chargeback.reads: Azure Cost Management, Microsoft Fabric and Microsoft Graph
11-fabric-finops-chargeback.delivers: HTML report, two CSVs and JSON
11-fabric-finops-chargeback.caption: Sample report with anonymised data.

case_0_v3.name: The use-case builder
case_0_v3.key: We need a report nobody has built yet
case_0_v3.symptom: We need a monthly report that none of these use cases covers yet.
case_0_v3.does: Describe the idea in one sentence. The agent writes the tool, tests it against your real data and hands back everything needed to run it as a new use case: the four building blocks, the exact permissions and a setup guide.
case_0_v3.delivers: A tested tool, skill, subagent and scheduled task
case_0_v3.changes: Nothing. The use cases it builds are read-only too
case_0_v3.caption: The builder at work.
